Wrapped reason explains blocked checkout. Real command plus CanOpenCheckout gates. Cancel uses request-clear confirmation command and CanEditOperation, rather than unconditional clear.

Amount wraps and MinHeight52 rather than fixed narrow row, helping large sums. ThemeResource text/background pairs follow active theme except converter-selected white segments. No full receipt preview or print invocation here.
